regions.merged_text: Wilfred Graveline - 32 - Frumbley's cousin - quarreled with his father three yrs. ago, left note wished never to see home again. Father also wished never to see son in this world. Boy in shack away in northern Canada saves two missionaries from freezing who assure him his father had forgiven him ... real prodigal son meeting ... last month returned - was seen lingering at the gate in zero weather hesitating to come in. On hearing W's name the Father in shirt sleeves rose from dinner and ran without coat to embrace him. Both wept. Now everything fine.
